summary: Iter-2 testing focused on 4 new features (Import Wizard, Notifikasi Insentif, Restore DB, PDF Rekap) + light regression. Backend pytest suite (8 new cases in test_iter2_features.py) 8/8 passing. Frontend Playwright: PDF download as AO 003 returned a valid application/pdf (27,846 bytes, %PDF magic); Restore flow completed end-to-end (backup → confirm modal → Ya, Restore Sekarang → post-restore admin login still succeeds with preserved password); Import Wizard preview modal opened with correct summary counts (Total: 2 baris, Valid: 1, Error: 1) and error badges per row; Notification bell shows unread badge '1' for Admin after Direktur rejects incentive (visually confirmed via screenshot after page reload); Executive Dashboard regression renders Pembiayaan/Funding/Recovery KPIs.
critical_code_review_comments: data_mgmt.py restore endpoint deletes and re-inserts entire collections without a DB transaction — an insert_many failure mid-restore leaves the DB partially wiped. Auto-backup snapshot goes to object storage (put_object) not local disk; if storage fails it is silently swallowed. Consider two-phase apply (write to shadow collections, then rename) or at least wrap in a Motor session with a transaction (requires MongoDB replica-set).

data_mgmt.py restore preserves current password_hash by matching ObjectId — this only works when the backup contains the same _id values. If Admin restores from a snapshot taken on a different environment, all users get the default password, effectively an account wipe. Consider matching by kode_marketing as a fallback.

notifications router: recipient scoping is by user['jabatan'] role only — every Admin (currently one) sees every 'Admin' notification. When multiple Admins are added, none can dismiss another's notification. Acceptable for MVP, worth noting for future.
reports.py ao-pdf uses ObjectId(ao_id) without try/except — malformed id will 500 instead of returning 400.

data_mgmt.py import_commit trusts the client-sent 'rows' payload (including _resolved_user_id) — a crafted request could rebind rows to any AO regardless of the earlier preview validation. Re-validate on commit.
NotificationBell polls unread every 30s; would benefit from re-fetch on window focus and on explicit action success (already does on open, good).
